rationale: This is a motor vehicle collision with vehicle damage and policyholder injury; auto claims take precedence over property_damage or liability when a vehicle is the primary loss.
severity_rationale: Total vehicle loss combined with bodily injury (whiplash and sprained wrist requiring treatment) meets high-severity criteria; injuries involving medical treatment beyond first aid elevate any claim to high.
claim_summary: High-severity auto collision: policyholder rear-ended at red light on Route 9 by other driver going ~35 mph with no braking. Vehicle totaled (trunk crushed into back seat). Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information. $750 deductible applies.
